description: FlashAttention + FlashInfer LayerNorm for audio encoder layer

sources.content:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from flash_attn import flash_attn_func
import flashinfer.norm


@torch.no_grad()
def run(
    input_features,
    conv1_weight, conv1_bias, conv2_weight, conv2_bias,
    embed_positions_weight,
    self_attn_layer_norm_weight, self_attn_layer_norm_bias,
    q_proj_weight, q_proj_bias, k_proj_weight, v_proj_weight, v_proj_bias,
    out_proj_weight, out_proj_bias,
    final_layer_norm_weight, final_layer_norm_bias,
    fc1_weight, fc1_bias, fc2_weight, fc2_bias,
):
    d_model = 5120
    num_heads = 20
    head_dim = 256
    scaling = head_dim ** -0.5
    ln_eps = 1e-5

    # Stage 1: Conv feature extraction (cuDNN)
    x = F.conv1d(input_features, conv1_weight, conv1_bias, padding=1)
    x = F.gelu(x)
    x = F.conv1d(x, conv2_weight, conv2_bias, stride=2, padding=1)
    x = F.gelu(x)
    x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)

    bsz, seq_len, _ = x.shape
    hidden_states = x + embed_positions_weight

    # === Self-attention block ===
    residual = hidden_states

    # LayerNorm via FlashInfer
    x_flat = hidden_states.reshape(-1, d_model).contiguous()
    hidden_states = flashinfer.norm.layernorm(
        x_flat, self_attn_layer_norm_weight, self_attn_layer_norm_bias, ln_eps
    ).reshape(bsz, seq_len, d_model)

    # QKV projection (Q is pre-scaled in reference, but we let FA do scaling)
    query_states = F.linear(hidden_states, q_proj_weight, q_proj_bias)
    key_states = F.linear(hidden_states, k_proj_weight, None)
    value_states = F.linear(hidden_states, v_proj_weight, v_proj_bias)

    # FlashAttention format: [batch, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim]
    query_states = query_states.view(bsz, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim).contiguous()
    key_states = key_states.view(bsz, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim).contiguous()
    value_states = value_states.view(bsz, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim).contiguous()

    # Non-causal attention (audio encoder)
    attn_output = flash_attn_func(query_states, key_states, value_states, causal=False, softmax_scale=scaling)
    attn_output = attn_output.reshape(bsz, seq_len, d_model)

    attn_output = F.linear(attn_output, out_proj_weight, out_proj_bias)
    hidden_states = residual + attn_output

    # === FFN block ===
    residual = hidden_states
    x_flat = hidden_states.reshape(-1, d_model).contiguous()
    hidden_states = flashinfer.norm.layernorm(
        x_flat, final_layer_norm_weight, final_layer_norm_bias, ln_eps
    ).reshape(bsz, seq_len, d_model)

    hidden_states = F.linear(hidden_states, fc1_weight, fc1_bias)
    hidden_states = F.gelu(hidden_states)
    hidden_states = F.linear(hidden_states, fc2_weight, fc2_bias)

    return residual + hidden_states
